reviewer.basis: Different agent from helper adapter/coordinator /root; read-only inspection and inert AST probes only.

scope: Eight temporary publication helpers plus helper config and retained round104-to-round105 adaptation diffs. Exact hashes are captured below. Original main is read-only during review.

findings.title: Finalization accepts incomplete postmerge validation evidence

evidence.name: finalize_accepts_incomplete_postmerge_evidence
evidence.method: Execute exact AST prefix through hosted-assessment checks; stop before preservation inspection or any Git command.
evidence.implication: The checked prefix would allow progression to main-preservation/fetch/fast-forward operations despite incomplete postmerge gate evidence. No external or repository mutation was executed.

findings.required_correction: Before any main fetch or fast-forward, require exact postmerge mode/base/topic/tree/merge binding, a complete required successful validation command set, successful coverage and measured counts, and current config/helper digests matching the commit receipt and postmerge receipt. Retain existing log and coverage digest verification.
acceptance_checks: A valid postmerge receipt is accepted.
An empty command set and each missing required validation/coverage command are rejected.
A nonzero required gate, failed coverage or changed counts is rejected.
Changed current or receipt config/verification/coverage/guard digests are rejected.
All evidence checks precede the first main mutation.

findings.title: Cleanup deletion does not verify the Git remote repository

evidence.name: cleanup_does_not_bind_git_origin
evidence.method: Execute exact cleanup try-body with inert Git/API fixtures; no subprocess functions are available.
evidence.implication: An otherwise matching branch SHA on a changed origin is deleted without verifying the repository URL. SHA lease protects branch content, not repository identity.

findings.required_correction: Require the expected CMMMech origin URL before any remote branch deletion, alongside the existing exact SHA lease and local compare-and-delete guards.
acceptance_checks: Expected origin with all existing PR/tree/SHA guards satisfied is accepted.
A different origin is rejected before git push, checkout or update-ref.
Moved remote or local refs remain rejected and the inspected worktree stays preserved.

positive_checks: Commit requires terminal complete batch checks, unchanged current record hashes, scientific coverage, explicit allowed paths, clean tracked changes, one-parent base and expected origin.
Push binds config/guard digests, exact head/tree/branch/parent, origin, absent remote branch and live base before publication.

Queue requires successful isolated preflight with required validations, coverage, current helper/config hashes, exact PR text/files/head/base, required hosted check, native squash queue rules, assessed discussion and immediate live-main comparison.
Cleanup verifies actual merged PR, sole base parent and exact tree, retains the worktree, uses a remote SHA lease and local compare-and-delete, and preserves review provenance tags.

Fresh verification constructs a squash-shaped tree or checks actual merge in a main-only clone with fetched tags and without topic commit availability; current scientific review coverage matches IDs, paths and hashes.
Original-main finalization compares retained nontracked byte hashes, sizes, modes and symlink targets, rejects added-path collisions and uses --no-overwrite-ignore.

checks.details: Both deliberately invalid inputs advanced past their relevant guard blocks; no subprocess or GitHub calls were executed.

limitations: ROUND105 topic/tree/PR/preflight/issue placeholders and provisional counts intentionally await coordinator binding. This audit is not publication authorization or a claim that hosted checks passed.
The probes demonstrate missing guard checks, not an observed wrong-repository deletion or incomplete real validation run.
The retained original-main preservation inventory was inspected by structure and bound hash; this audit does not independently enumerate all current original-main content.
Pure receipt checks are defense in depth under trusted local invocation; assertions are not hardened against an adversarial Python runtime.
corrections: None applied by reviewer; initial audit remains immutable. Coordinator will address findings and request a successor review.
unresolved_questions: Exact final topic/tree/PR/issue bindings and measured corpus counts remain pending.
Native queue and final hosted/latest-attempt evidence must be assessed after those events occur.
